exposure_anchors.1: Negligible: domestic-only counterparties, no UBO complexity, no dual-use goods, no high-risk jurisdictions in supply chain.
exposure_anchors.2: Limited: occasional EU-based cross-border counterparties; no sanctioned-jurisdiction touchpoints.
exposure_anchors.3: Moderate: cross-border activity beyond EU; supply chain or customer base touches one or two higher-risk jurisdictions.
exposure_anchors.4: High: regular activity in or with sanctioned-adjacent jurisdictions; complex UBO chains; dual-use or restricted goods.
exposure_anchors.5: Severe: direct activity in heavily sanctioned regimes; defence / dual-use / energy supply chain; correspondent / nominee structures.

threat_credibility_anchors.1: No active sanctions enforcement targeting this profile.
threat_credibility_anchors.2: Documented but rare enforcement in this sector / jurisdiction.
threat_credibility_anchors.3: Active enforcement in the operating jurisdictions; OFAC / OFSI bulletins reference the sector.
threat_credibility_anchors.4: Active and adapted: typology in active use; circumvention via re-routing common.
threat_credibility_anchors.5: Active and targeted: entity has prior alerts or enforcement contact; sector is a stated enforcement priority.

vulnerability_anchors.1: Real-time fuzzy screening + UBO + adverse-media + end-use; recent independent audit.
vulnerability_anchors.2: Real-time screening with minor coverage gaps; periodic audit.
vulnerability_anchors.3: Screening present but with stale lists / exact-match-only / no UBO depth.
vulnerability_anchors.4: Screening partial or batch-only; no UBO; no adverse-media; no end-use checks.
vulnerability_anchors.5: No screening, or screening documented but not operating.
